arxiv-1808-06718.title: Loss Data Analytics
arxiv-1808-06718.creator: An open text authored by the Actuarial Community
arxiv-1808-06718.description: Abstract Preface Book Description Loss Data Analytics is an interactive, online, freely available text. • The online version contains many interactive objects (quizzes, computer demonstrations, interactive graphs, video, and the like) to promote deeper learning . • A subset of the book is available for offline reading in pdf and EPUB formats.

arxiv-2001-00015.title: Average angles of triangle in regular polygons
arxiv-2001-00015.creator: Herman Muzychko
arxiv-2001-00015.description: Abstract In this article we will consider average angles of triangle, which share the same side with regular polygons. In particular we will count average angles in the triangle, which share the same bottom side with a square with length side d = 1 d=1 . 1 Introduction Whenever we are talking about something average of continuity, we use integrals.

arxiv-2103-16316.title: Leveraging a Joint of Phenotypic and Genetic Features on Cancer Patient Subgrouping
arxiv-2103-16316.creator: DODavid Oniani, CWChen Wang, YZYiqing Zhao, WAAndrew Wen, HLHongfang Liu, FSFeichen Shen
arxiv-2103-16316.description: Abstract \parttitle Background Cancer is responsible for millions of deaths worldwide every year. Although significant progress has been achieved in cancer medicine, many issues remain to be addressed for improving cancer therapy. Appropriate cancer patient stratification is the prerequisite for selecting appropriate treatment plan, as cancer patients are of known heterogeneous genetic make-ups and phenotypic differences.

arxiv-2110-01051.title: Surjectivity of linear operators and semialgebraic global diffeomorphisms Thanks: ∗ Partial support provided by the grants 2019/07316-0 and 2020/14498-4 of the São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP) Thanks: † Partial support provided by the Grant 304163/2017-1 of the National Council for Scientific
arxiv-2110-01051.creator: Francisco Braun ∗ , Luis Renato Gonçalves Dias † and Jean Venato-Santos ‡
arxiv-2110-01051.description: Abstract . We prove that a C ∞ C^{\infty} semialgebraic local diffeomorphism of ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} with non-properness set having codimension greater than or equal to 2 2 is a global diffeomorphism if n − 1 n-1 suitable linear partial differential operators are surjective.

arxiv-2110-09374.title: Ortho-Shot: Low Displacement Rank Regularization with Data Augmentation for Few-Shot Learning
arxiv-2110-09374.creator: Uche Osahor, Nasser M. Nasrabadi
arxiv-2110-09374.description: Abstract In few-shot classification, the primary goal is to learn representations from a few samples that generalize well for novel classes. In this paper, we propose an efficient low displacement rank (LDR) regularization strategy termed Ortho-Shot; a technique that imposes orthogonal regularization on the convolutional layers of a few-shot classifier, which is based on the doubly-block toeplitz (DBT) matrix structure.

arxiv-2209-14931.title: Reference Optical Turbulence and Wind Profiles for Single Conjugate and Extreme Adaptive Optics 2022 Reference Optical Turbulence and Wind Profiles for Single Conjugate and Extreme Adaptive Optics – References
arxiv-2209-14931.creator: O. J. D. Farley
arxiv-2209-14931.description: Abstract We present a simple method of extracting a small number of reference optical turbulence and wind profiles from a large dataset for single conjugate and extreme adaptive optics simulations. These reference profiles can be used in slow end-to-end adaptive optics simulations to represent the variability of the atmosphere.

arxiv-2307-06980.title: Observed Patterns of Surface Solar Irradiance under Cloudy and Clear-sky Conditions
arxiv-2307-06980.creator: Wouter Mol (wbmol@wur.nl), Bert Heusinkveld, Mary Rose Mangan, Oscar Hartogensis, Menno Veerman, Chiel van Heerwaarden
arxiv-2307-06980.description: Abstract Surface solar irradiance varies on scales as small as seconds or meters due to scattering and absorption by the atmosphere. Clouds are the main driver of this variability, but moisture structures in the atmospheric boundary layer and aerosols have an influence too, and depend on wavelength.

arxiv-2401-01377.title: Does Few-shot Learning Suffer from Backdoor Attacks?
arxiv-2401-01377.creator: Xinwei Liu, Xiaojun Jia, Jindong Gu, Yuan Xun, Siyuan Liang, Xiaochun Cao
arxiv-2401-01377.description: Abstract The field of few-shot learning (FSL) has shown promising results in scenarios where training data is limited, but its vulnerability to backdoor attacks remains largely unexplored. We first explore this topic by first evaluating the performance of the existing backdoor attack methods on few-shot learning scenarios.

arxiv-2504-06206.title: Antiferromagnetism and spin excitations in a two-dimensional non-Hermitian Hatano-Nelson flux model
arxiv-2504-06206.creator: Eduard Naichuk, Ilya M. Eremin, Jeroen van den Brink, Flavio S. Nogueira
arxiv-2504-06206.description: Abstract The one-dimensional Hatano-Nelson model with non-reciprocal hoppings is a prominent example of a relatively simple non-Hermitian quantum-mechanical system, which allows to study various phenomena in open quantum systems without adding extra gain and loss terms. Here we propose to use it as a building block to construct a correlated non-Hermitian Hamiltonian in two dimensions.

arxiv-2508-19682.title: Public Persuasion with Endogenous Fact-Checking Working Paper — August 10, 2026 Thanks: We thank Olivier Gossner, Johannes Hörner, Yukio Koriyama, Yves Le Yaoanq, Alessandro Riboni, François Salanié, Anna Sanktjohanser, Ludvig Sinander, Nikita Zakharov and all the participants of the PEDD 2023 Confe
arxiv-2508-19682.creator: Georgy Lukyanov, Samuel Safaryan
arxiv-2508-19682.description: Abstract We study public persuasion when a sender faces a mass audience that can verify the state at heterogeneous costs. The sender commits ex ante to a public information policy but must satisfy an ex post truthfulness constraint on verifiable content (EPIC).

arxiv-2510-14747.title: The predictive power of the calculated line lists of carbon monoxide
arxiv-2510-14747.creator: E. S. Medvedev, V. G. Ushakov
arxiv-2510-14747.description: Abstract The ability of our semi-empirical irregular dipole-moment functions (2022) and (2025) to predict the intensities of the yet unobserved lines, as well as to describe the observed ones not used in the fitting, is demonstrated by comparison with recent measurements in the 0-0, 1-0, 3-0, and 7-0 bands.

arxiv-2511-17273.title: Investigation of the Spectator Effect on Light Nuclei Production in Nucleus-Nucleus Collisions at High Baryon Density Region Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2511-17273.creator: Li’Ang Zhang, Hongcan Li, Junyi Han, Yaping Wang, Junlin Wu, Guannan Xie, Gao-Chan Yong
arxiv-2511-17273.description: Abstract The light nuclei yields and yield ratios, as sensitive probes of the QCD phase transition, have been precisely measured at various collision energies. However, due to limited detector acceptance, the full p T p_{\rm T} integral yield often requires extrapolation of the measured transverse momentum spectra to the unmeasured low- p T p_{\rm T} region via functional fitting.

arxiv-2512-02896.title: Ridged geometries induce axial flow vortices in Couette systems
arxiv-2512-02896.creator: Akankshya Majhi, Maria Raquel Serial, Lars Kool, Jasper van der Gucht, Joshua A. Dijksman
arxiv-2512-02896.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Akankshya Majhi, Maria Raquel Serial, Lars Kool, Jasper van der Gucht, Joshua A. Dijksman. A yield stress fluid has a critical stress above which the material starts to flow. Typically, the yield stress behaviour is captured in the Herschel-Bulkley (HB) model, which assumes a constant yield stress as material parameter.

pmc-10643673.title: An immunomodulating peptide with potential to suppress tumour growth and autoimmunity
pmc-10643673.creator: Michael Agrez, Christopher Chandler, Kristofer J Thurecht, Nicholas L Fletcher, Feifei Liu, Gayathri Subramaniam, Christopher B Howard, Benjamin Blyth, Stephen Parker, Darryl Turner, Justyna Rzepecka, Gavin Knox, Anastasia Nika, Andrew M Hall, Hayley Gooding, Laura Gallagher
pmc-10643673.description: Cancers and autoimmune diseases commonly co-exist and immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy (ICI) exacerbates autoimmune pathologies. We recently described a lipidic peptide, designated IK14004, that promotes expansion of immunosuppressive T regulatory (Treg) cells and uncouples interleukin-2 from interferon-gamma production while activating CD8+ T cells.

pmc-11289788.title: Direct and indirect cumulative effects of temperature, nutrients, and light on phytoplankton growth
pmc-11289788.creator: Anna Lena Heinrichs, Onja Johannes Hardorp, Helmut Hillebrand, Toni Schott, Maren Striebel
pmc-11289788.description: Temperature and resource availability are pivotal factors influencing phytoplankton community structures. Numerous prior studies demonstrated their significant influence on phytoplankton stoichiometry, cell size, and growth rates. The growth rate, serving as a reflection of an organism's success within its environment, is linked to stoichiometry and cell size.

pmc-11351728.title: Oncolytic Tanapoxvirus Variants Expressing mIL-2 and mCCL-2 Regress Human Pancreatic Cancer Xenografts in Nude Mice †
pmc-11351728.creator: Scott D Haller, Karim Essani, Satoshi Wada
pmc-11351728.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is the fifth leading cause of cancer-related death and presents the lowest 5-year survival rate of any form of cancer in the US. Only 20% of PDAC patients are suitable for surgical resection and adjuvant chemotherapy, which remains the only curative treatment. Chemotherapeutic and gene therapy treatments are associated with adverse effects and lack specificity/efficacy.

pmc-11692780.title: DETERMINANTS OF AGE AT NATURAL MENOPAUSE AMONG POSTMENOPAUSAL GHANAIAN WOMEN IN OKAIKWEI NORTH DISTRICT, GHANA
pmc-11692780.creator: Okyere Kontor, Veneranda Nyarko, Paul Botwe
pmc-11692780.description: The age at natural menopause, influenced by genetic and modifiable factors is linked to the risk of certain chronic conditions. While menopause has been studied extensively in other countries, there is limited data on its determinants among women in developing countries like Ghana, creating a theory gap for investigations.

pmc-12464551.title: Pressure-pain thresholds of the plantar foot reflect relative tissue thickness and are systematically higher in active runners than non-runners
pmc-12464551.creator: Claire Game, Tom Walsh, Nathan Stevenson, Werner Klingler, Scott C. Wearing
pmc-12464551.description: BackgroundAthletes have been shown to have greater tolerance and, to a lesser extent, a lower sensitivity to mechanical pain. However, little is known as to whether the pressure-pain sensitivity of the plantar tissues of the foot of runners, which are exposed to repeated, high-impact forces during running, differs to those of non-runners.

pmc-12587511.title: Assessing the accuracy of survival machine learning and traditional statistical models for Alzheimer's disease prediction over time: a study on the ADNI cohort
pmc-12587511.creator: Sardar Jahani, Ghodratollah Roshanaei, Leili Tapak
pmc-12587511.description: BackgroundMild cognitive impairment (MCI) represents a transitional stage to Alzheimer's disease (AD), making progression prediction crucial for timely intervention. Predictive models integrating clinical, laboratory, and survival data can enhance early diagnosis and treatment decisions. While machine learning approaches effectively handle censored data, their application in MCI-to-AD progression prediction remains limited, with unclear superiority over classical survival models.

pmc-12653667.title: Pediatric Burns: Biological and Tissue Engineered Skin Substitutes—A Systematic Review
pmc-12653667.creator: Pietro Susini, Martina Certini, Gianluca Marcaccini, Ruggero Mazzotta, Roberto Cuomo, Giuseppe Nisi, Luca Grimaldi, Flavio Facchini
pmc-12653667.description: Background/Objectives: Surgical debridement and early excision of burned areas followed by skin autograft is the gold standard of treatment for partial and full-thickness pediatric burns. However, skin autografting might be unfeasible or unlikely to succeed due limited availability of skin donor areas or inadequate conditions. In these circumstances, alternative treatment is required, and Skin Substitutes (SS) cold play a role.

pmc-13154983.title: Early postnatal antibiotic-associated gut microbiota alterations might promote long-term lipid metabolism via brown adipose tissue metabolic programming
pmc-13154983.creator: Huijing Liang, Fengling Jiang, Lei Ren, Xiaoting Li, Simou Wu, Jinxing Li, Liang Li, Xiaolei Ze, Xi Shen, Fang He
pmc-13154983.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Developmental Origins of Health and Disease theory describes early life as a critical window for long-term metabolic health. Accumulating evidence has identified the gut microbiota as a key mediator of early-life metabolic programming. This study utilized antibiotic intervention in neonatal mice to investigate the long-term effects of early postnatal gut microbiota perturbations on adult lipid metabolism and examined the underlying mechanisms involving both thermogenic adipose tissue programming and microbiota structural remodeling.

pmc-13356688.title: Phylogenetic and molecular insights into the genetic diversity of the invasive nematode Ashworthius sidemi infecting Poland's free-ranging European bison (Bison bonasus)
pmc-13356688.creator: Magdalena Świsłocka-Cutter, Anetta Borkowska, Rafał Kowalczyk, Marta Kołodziej-Sobocińska
pmc-13356688.description: The invasive blood-sucking nematode Ashworthius sidemi, originally parasitising Asian cervids, has spread across Europe following human-mediated introductions of sika deer (Cervus nippon). In this study, we characterised the molecular variation of A. sidemi obtained from two neighbouring populations of European bison (Bison bonasus) in northeastern Poland, located in the Białowieża Primeval Forest and Knyszyńska Forest.

pmc-13679774.title: Sociodemographic and Clinical Profile of Adult Males With Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
pmc-13679774.creator: Manju Jayasimha Pula Jayaram, Hollie A. Clark, Natalie Street, Yining Yang, Shannon Kilburn, Shiny Thomas, Christina Westfield, Katherine D. Mathews, Emma Ciafaloni, Aida Soim, Muscular Dystrophy Surveillance, Tracking, and Research Network (MD STAR
pmc-13679774.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction/Aims:Due to improvements in clinical care, individuals with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) are living into adulthood, but little has been published about adults with DMD.
